g.aria-label: Calibrating Fréchet Distance: The +O(1/n) Finite-Sample Bias Floor
Sample covariance Σ̂ fluctuates by O(n⁻¹/²)
Upward trace bias scales as +O(1 / n)
Two Iron Laws of FD Evaluation
1. Never compare FD across different n!
2. Report the real-vs.-real floor at n
An FD of 0.82 at n = 5,000 is 5× the real floor (0.17); at n = 1,000 it equals the floor!
